title: [Bug 649379] Composite layout stress-test fixes, part resolution source and status action captions
summary: Fixes composite report layout defects: a new layout can no longer overwrite one with the same name, default layouts must stay Approved, and empty uploads are rejected. Blank header/footer parts can be created. Show layout parts now resolves the effective layout correctly, and status actions read Set as ....
key_points: New layouts with a taken name are rejected; only Replace deletes the old layout, after a successful upload
An Approved layout explicitly selected as default cannot change status, and only approved layouts can become default
Empty uploads are rejected with a dedicated error
Blank header/footer parts can be created with the report's WordXmlPart
Show layout parts uses the report's effective layout; status captions changed to Set as ...
quote: A duplicate name silently overwrote an existing layout.
